details:
Rather than watching the community dumpster fire, why don't you guys be useful and start converting all the negativity into data sets, clearly you guys haven't took your time and thought about this during your 1 day span, you even told influencers about this a week ago so you had plenty of time to think. You may as well sort and compile all complaints into useable data. Do some diligence and focus on the problem for the most sincere experienced player from the game. Ligit doing a "No Man Sky", too many promises and too little features. The current state of VRChat is this now due to the removal of 3rd party features. Why not do what Sean Murray did, create a list of features that needs to be added and prioritize on the features that must be added. Focusing on Quest user completely ignores the problems and will leave a majority of the people venerable to the problem your already dealing. EAC just made your job much more harder by removing most of the protective 3rd party software meaning a increase in account lost and crashing complaints.
Since the damage is done, you already understand denial and PR or Corporate announcement will just be adding fuel to the fire. Rolling back is probably your last resort, I hope. watching this go down isn't helping you guys and us. Anything useful in the next 24hour is more helpful that waiting indefinitely. Learn from other companies mistakes, do some proper market research because this event clearly doesn't show your competent. An ongoing similar problem is Minecraft adding Chat moderation to a "social game", same goes for your "social game", restricting part of the community is the same as silencing a minority. Getting jealous at better creator is just going to slow down VRChat development, HR may as well look for more suitable and more productive people.
title: Diligence on negativity
